title: Ali Baba part 2 and questions
subject: Arabic
unit: Spring 2: Ali Baba and the forty thieves; occasions
source: Written for arabic/y6 lesson 10 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Ali Baba part 2 and questions)
intro: Lesson 10: Ali Baba (part 2) and questions. Read the Arabic aloud, then do the tasks. Write in Arabic with all the harakat.

arabic.text:
ذَهَبَ قَاسِمٌ، أَخُو عَلِي بَابَا، إِلَى المَغَارَةِ.
كَانَ قَاسِمٌ طَمَّاعًا، فَأَخَذَ كَثِيرًا مِنَ الذَّهَبِ.
نَسِيَ الكَلِمَاتِ، فَلَمْ يَسْتَطِعْ أَنْ يَخْرُجَ!
جَاءَ عَلِي بَابَا وَقَالَ: اِفْتَحْ يَا سِمْسِمُ، فَخَرَجَ قَاسِمٌ.
أَخَذَ عَلِي بَابَا الكَنْزَ إِلَى القَاضِي لِيُرْجِعَهُ إِلَى أَصْحَابِهِ.

panels.title: Meaning
points: Qasim, the greedy brother, took lots of gold
He forgot the words and was stuck
Ali Baba freed him and took the treasure to the judge

questions.q: Why couldn't Qasim get out? Answer in Arabic.
Questions and lesson on the pupil PDF: five questions on part 2 (three in Arabic), then in the portal response box: 'The lesson of the story is ... because ...' (English or Arabic).
questions.a: Answers from the text; lesson: honesty and avoiding greed, returning what is not ours (4:58)

questions.q: Extend: describe Ali Baba with two adjectives in Arabic.
Stretch: change the ending: what else could Ali Baba have done that is fair?
questions.a: For example: told the people of the town and the judge.

questions.q: Where did Ali Baba take the treasure?
questions.a: A) إِلَى القَاضِي. To the judge, to return it to its owners.

questions.q: Think again: why do greedy people end up in trouble?
questions.a: Greed makes them careless and unfair.
